name: Saudi Automotive Services Company
summary: Saudi Automotive Services Company owns and operates a network of motor vehicle service stations in Saudi Arabia. It operates through Retail and Operations; SASCO Palm; Saudi Club; Transportation Fleet; and Others segments.
